name: Verify the Weight card progress bar is visible and clicking the Weight card opens the weight modal or panel, which is then closed
Verify opening Set Targets shows the Set Your Target heading and the Meals, Exercise, and Weight section containers, then navigates back to dashboard via the Back button
Verify the Meals card progress bar is visible and clicking the Meals card navigates to the food page
Verify the Weight Loss Progress card displays the three key data labels: Current Weight, Target Weight, and the percentage progress value
Given I logged into web app as a user, when user's cohort dpp date is in week52, then user should see weekly progress title as 'Week 52/52'
Verify after saving targets of 3 meals, 30 min exercise, 3 weight days, the weekly card help texts show the correct format: X/3 Days for meals and weight, X/210 Minutes for exercise
Verify Weight Loss Progress card is visible with its label, Set Targets button, and weekly progress title all rendered on the dashboard
Verify clicking the Meals weekly card routes to the food page and the Add Food button is visible
Verify the Medication page renders with the date navigator, Log tab, Your Medication tab, and Add Medication dropdown button all visible and enabled
When target value updated then Target Value in Home page should be updated along with the Target Percentage
Verify the Home/Dashboard nav link has the active CSS class applied, confirming the browser is currently on the dashboard route
Verify adding a weight entry from Health works, then return to dashboard

Verify Set Targets correctly calculates grams per macronutrient based on a 2500 calorie target and the current macro percentages, with displayed gram values matching the expected calculation within a 3g tolerance
Verify the Weight and Exercise history panels each show either delete action buttons for existing entries or the No data recorded yet empty state message
Verify the Fitness Videos page renders with a Fitness Videos section header and at least one group header card visible
Verify the Recipe Book page renders with its header, all three recipe type tabs (Habi's Recipes, Search the Web, My Recipes), and the Generate New Recipe button is enabled
Verify Set Targets saves successfully when Meals=3 days, Exercise=30 min/day, Weight=3 days, Target weight=170 lbs are entered, and the Meals help text appears on the dashboard after redirect
Verify Set Targets macro total workflow: default is 100%, editing to 90% blocks save, restoring to 100% allows save
Verify the Current Weight value and percentage metric on the Weight Loss card are non-empty before and after navigating to the Health page and returning, confirming data persists across navigation
Verify Set Targets plus/minus buttons increment and decrement meals, and Lbs/Kg toggle updates selection correctly
Verify entering 170 lbs in the Weight add panel and saving shows the Created weight success toast, then closes the modal and returns to the dashboard
Verify notification badge count beside the bell is a valid non-negative integer and not broken text when visible
Verify entering 1000 steps in the Exercise add panel and saving shows the Created exercise success toast, then closes the modal and returns to the dashboard
Verify clicking the Health nav link renders health card section headers: Weight, Exercise, Blood Sugar, Blood Pressure, Tobacco Count, and HbA1c
Verify on the Food page the Previous date button is enabled to allow navigating back, but the Next date button is disabled since today is the most recent allowed date
When latest weight added is deleted then Current Value in Home page should show the previous weight
Verify the Food page renders all four meal section headers (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks) and all three macro labels (Carbs, Protein, Fat)
Graph shows 2% after a small weight loss
Graph shows ~45% after significant weight loss
Graph is fully filled when goal weight is reached
Verify the Discussion board composer is ready with Share title, subject input, and body textarea visible, and if posts exist, the first post author and comment input are displayed

Verify Set Targets water intake input enforces boundary rules: decrementing below minimum clamps to min, incrementing above maximum clamps to max, entering 0 snaps to min, and entering an out-of-range large value snaps to max
Verify the Habits page shows the Active Habits toggle, exactly 7 weekly calendar day blocks when present, and the Taking Medication habit card description and frequency label when it exists
Verify navigating to Learn or Videos (based on program config) correctly renders the section header for whichever variant is active
New User Join: Starting weight equals Current Weight, Target weight from banner, and 0% weight loss
Verify navigating to Health shows the Exercise card title and the history panel open button for Exercise logs
Verify navigating to Health shows the Weight card title and the history panel open button for Weight logs
Verify the Medication page opens with the Log tab active by default (has active CSS class) and the Today's Log heading is displayed
Verify every main nav link is present and visible: Home, Food, Health, Habits, and either Learn or Videos
Graph shows 0% when no weight has been lost
Verify clicking the Discussion explore card routes to /app/discussion and renders the Discuss and My Posts tabs
Verify Set Targets date navigator disables all inputs when navigating to a past date (read-only historical data) and re-enables them when returning to today's date
Verify the Habits page renders with the Active Habits toggle button and the Add button both visible
Given I logged into web app as a user, when user's cohort program hasn't started, then user should not see weekly progress title
Verify the weekly progress bar area shows a title matching 'Week X/Y' format, the progress bar is visible, and its ARIA attributes aria-valuemin=0 and aria-valuemax=100 are correct
Verify all four Explore section shortcut buttons are visible on the dashboard: Discussion, Recipe Book, Fitness Videos, and Medication
Verify clicking the Discussion menu button reveals all three dropdown options: Talk to My Coach, Talk to My Team, and View My Meetings
Verify clicking the Food nav link routes to /app/food and renders the date navigator, food page container, and Logs header
Verify adding an exercise entry from Health works, then return to dashboard
When new weight is added then Current Weight value in Home page should be updated
Verify top header renders correctly: HabitNu logo, discussion menu button, notification bell, and profile dropdown are all visible
Given I logged into web app as a user, when user's cohort dpp date is in week52, then user should see weekly progress title as 'Week 52/52' & completely filled progress-bar
Verify profile dropdown contains all expected options
Given I logged into web app as a user, when user's cohort dpp date is in week2, then user should see weekly progress title as 'Week 2/52'
Verify clicking the arrow/SVG icon on the Weight Loss card routes the browser to the Health page at /app/health
Verify the Exercise card progress bar is visible and clicking the Exercise card opens the exercise modal or panel, which is then closed
Given I logged into web app as a user, when user's cohort dpp date is in week1, then user should see weekly progress title as 'Week 1/52'
Verify the Learn page shows its header and at least one stats chip, or the Videos page shows Program Videos, Demo Videos, and the first video title based on program variant
Verify opening the notification panel via the bell icon shows the Mark All As Read action and at least one notification item
Verify the personalised welcome message/title element is visible on the dashboard page and correct for the user
Given I logged into web app as a user, when user's cohort dpp date has gone past 52 weeks, then user should not see weekly progress title
Verify the three This Week summary cards exist and display the correct labels: Meals, Weight, and Exercise
Verify a meal can be added using addMeals and logMeal helpers and then return to dashboard
Verify each of the Meals, Weight, and Exercise weekly card progress bars expose correct ARIA accessibility attributes: aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax=100, and aria-valuenow as a valid number
